description:
Founding CTO / Technical Co-Founder

**RoamYoo | Equity-Based Opportunity**

**Role:** Founding CTO / Technical Co-Founder  
**Company:** RoamYoo — Travel-Tech & Experiences Marketplace  
**Engagement:** Equity-based; ownership structure to be discussed transparently  
**Experience:** Strong builders with proven execution ability; exceptional self-taught engineers and early-stage founders are welcome.

About RoamYoo

RoamYoo is building a social-meets-marketplace travel platform that connects travelers with verified local hosts and authentic experiences across India.

From discovering destinations and booking local experiences to joining group trips, finding stays and transport, and connecting with trusted hosts, RoamYoo aims to make travel more personal, accessible, and community-driven.

Our vision is simple: **Book a person, not just a place.**

We are looking for a founding technical leader who can turn this vision into a real, working, production-ready product.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a **hands-on technical co-founder who can operate as a one-person engineering powerhouse in the early stages.**

You should be capable of taking a feature from a rough idea to a deployed, tested, and functioning product without needing a large engineering team or constant supervision.

You will own the complete technical lifecycle: product architecture, development, AI-assisted coding, integrations, databases, infrastructure, deployment, security, and production reliability.

We do not need someone who only manages developers, creates roadmaps, or talks about technology. We need someone who can **personally build, ship, maintain, and continuously improve the product.**

Key Responsibilities1. Build and Launch the Product

* Own the end-to-end technical development of RoamYoo, from MVP to production.
* Convert business requirements, user problems, and product ideas into functional features.
* Build and maintain frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, and admin tools.
* Develop marketplace capabilities such as user accounts, host profiles, experience listings, bookings, payments, reviews, notifications, and dashboards.
* Build responsive, mobile-first experiences and establish a practical roadmap for mobile applications.
* Ship usable features quickly without compromising essential quality, security, or maintainability.

2. Own the Entire Technical Stack

* Make sound architecture and technology decisions based on speed, cost, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Design secure APIs, database schemas, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Integrate payment gateways, maps, messaging, analytics, AI services, and other external systems as required.
* Establish clear development standards, reusable components, and maintainable code.
* Avoid unnecessary complexity and overengineering during the early stages.

3. Master AI-Assisted and Agentic Development

* Use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and GitHub Copilot effectively.
* Use AI coding agents to accelerate development, automate repetitive work, debug problems, and implement features.
* Break complex requirements into tasks that AI tools can execute reliably.
* Review and validate AI-generated code rather than blindly accepting it.
* Build automated workflows and AI-powered product features where they deliver real business value.

**We value engineering judgment and shipped outcomes, not the number of AI tools you know.**

4. Own Deployment, CI/CD, and Production

* Set up and maintain Git/GitHub workflows, branching, pull requests, and version control.
* Build CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment.
* Configure hosting, cloud infrastructure, environments, secrets, and database migrations.
* Implement automated tests, logging, error tracking, monitoring, backups, and rollback procedures.
* Diagnose production issues and resolve bugs independently.
* Ensure releases are repeatable, secure, and reliable rather than dependent on manual intervention.

5. Build for Trust, Security, and Scale

* Protect user accounts, personal information, payment flows, and business data.
* Implement appropriate access controls, validation, rate limiting, and secure secret management.
* Plan for marketplace growth, increasing traffic, transaction reliability, and operational complexity.
* Establish practical engineering documentation and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Make responsible decisions about technical debt and prioritize fixes based on actual risk.

6. Act as the Technical Owner

* Work directly with the founder to translate business priorities into engineering execution.
* Challenge impractical ideas, identify technical risks, and recommend better solutions.
* Estimate work realistically, communicate blockers early, and deliver agreed milestones.
* Take accountability for the systems you build and maintain.
* Eventually establish the engineering team, technical culture, and hiring standards as the company grows.

Must-Have Skills

* Strong practical software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to build and ship full-stack applications independently.
* Experience with a modern frontend framework such as React or Next.js.
* Backend development using Node.js, Python, or another suitable production-ready stack.
* Database design and practical experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent systems.
* API development, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Git/GitHub, code review, branching, and collaborative development workflows.
* CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Deployment experience with cloud platforms or modern hosting services.
* Testing, debugging, security fundamentals, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
* Practical experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real development work.
* Ability to evaluate trade-offs and make independent technical decisions.

You do not need to be an expert in every framework. You do need to be capable of selecting suitable tools, learning quickly, and delivering working systems.

Strong Advantages

* Experience founding, building, or leading the engineering of a startup.
* Previously launched products used by real customers.
* Marketplace, travel-tech, booking, payments, or SaaS experience.
* Experience with mobile development, React Native, or Flutter.
* Experience building AI agents, RAG systems, or AI-enabled workflows.
* Docker, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, and database performance tuning.
* Experience with analytics, experimentation, observability, and product instrumentation.
* Open-source contributions or a strong portfolio of independent projects.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for someone who:

* **Builds instead of merely discussing ideas.**
* Can take an ambiguous requirement and turn it into a working, deployed feature.
* Can work independently without requiring a team for every technical task.
* Understands that AI-generated code still requires engineering judgment.
* Is dependable, transparent, disciplined, and serious about commitments.
* Communicates delays, risks, and mistakes early instead of hiding them.
* Thinks about business outcomes, customer experience, and technology together.
* Is willing to take meaningful ownership and build for the long term.
* Can disagree constructively, challenge assumptions, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Wants to build a company, not simply complete assigned tickets.

Equity-Based Founding Opportunity

This is an equity-based founding role intended for someone who wants meaningful ownership and responsibility in building RoamYoo.

We want to be transparent about the arrangement:

* The equity percentage, vesting schedule, responsibilities, decision-making authority, and any cash compensation will be discussed explicitly before an agreement is signed.
* Equity is intended to align long-term contribution with the company's success; it should not be treated as a substitute for clearly defined expectations.
* The role requires sustained execution, product ownership, technical reliability, and commitment to the company's long-term development.
* Intellectual property ownership, confidentiality, founder departure, and equity vesting terms will be documented in an appropriate written agreement.
* We will evaluate candidates on demonstrated ability, ownership, commitment, and fit—not just years of experience or impressive titles.

**We want a genuine technical partner who can help build RoamYoo into a real business.**

How to Apply

Please share:

* Your GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant work.
* One or two products you personally built and launched.
* Your exact contribution to each project: architecture, coding, database, integrations, deployment, and maintenance.
* The technology stack and AI development tools you use in practice.
* An example of a difficult technical problem you solved independently.
* Your current availability, long-term commitment, and expectations from an equity-based founding role.

Candidates who can demonstrate a working product, explain their engineering decisions, and show evidence of independent execution will be prioritized.

**The key question is not what technologies you know. It is what you can independently build, launch, and take responsibility for.**

**Company:** RoamYoo  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–7 years preferred; exceptional builders with demonstrable production experience are welcome

About RoamYoo

RoamYoo is building an AI-powered, social-meets-marketplace travel platform that connects travellers with verified local hosts, authentic experiences, group trips, stays, transport, and community-driven travel opportunities.

We are looking for a highly capable, technology-driven professional who can take ownership of multiple applications, manage the complete product lifecycle, build AI-powered systems, automate engineering workflows, and ensure that every application is reliable, secure, scalable, and production-ready.

This is not a conventional Product Owner role focused on meetings, documentation, and task management.

We need a **hands-on technical owner who can think like a product manager, build like an engineer, automate like a DevOps specialist, and troubleshoot like a production engineer.**

Role Overview

You will own the complete lifecycle of multiple digital products and applications, from requirements and architecture to development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

You must understand how modern AI coding tools, agentic workflows, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation systems work together to deliver production-grade applications.

You will be expected to work independently, identify technical and product problems, implement solutions, coordinate with other developers when required, and take accountability for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Ownership & Application Management

* Own multiple web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, admin panels, and AI-powered products.
* Convert business requirements into product specifications, user stories, technical tasks, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage product roadmaps, sprint priorities, backlogs, releases, and dependencies.
* Understand user journeys, business logic, database relationships, API integrations, and application architecture.
* Coordinate product development from initial prototype to MVP and production release.
* Identify bottlenecks, technical debt, performance issues, and opportunities for automation.
* Maintain product documentation, system diagrams, API documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks.
* Ensure applications remain functional as requirements, users, integrations, and business processes evolve.

2. Agentic AI Systems & AI Engineering

* Design, implement, and maintain agentic AI workflows that can plan, execute tasks, use tools, and validate outcomes.
* Build multi-agent systems where appropriate, including orchestration, delegation, state management, retries, and human approval checkpoints.
* Work with LLM APIs, structured outputs, function calling, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and embeddings.
* Understand agent memory, context management, evaluation, guardrails, and failure recovery.
* Integrate AI agents with databases, internal applications, third-party APIs, browser tools, and business workflows.
* Develop reliable workflows rather than depending on unstructured prompts alone.
* Implement observability, tracing, evaluation datasets, token and latency monitoring, and cost controls.
* Know when to use a deterministic workflow instead of an autonomous agent.

**Relevant technologies:** OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, vector databases, and other relevant agent orchestration frameworks.

3. AI-Assisted & Agentic Software Development

* Work effectively with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI-assisted development environments.
* Use AI coding agents for implementation, debugging, refactoring, test generation, code review, and documentation.
* Create reusable project instructions, coding standards, agent skills, tool integrations, and repeatable development workflows.
* Design multi-step coding workflows with planning, implementation, testing, review, and validation.
* Understand the code being generated rather than blindly accepting AI-generated output.
* Review AI-generated code for security vulnerabilities, incorrect business logic, performance problems, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control, pull requests, branch protection, and code review practices.
* Establish a repeatable workflow for moving from an idea or prompt to tested, deployable software.

4. Full-Stack Development & System Architecture

* Understand and work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, authentication, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Build and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces.
* Design REST APIs and understand GraphQL where appropriate.
* Implement authentication, role-based access control, permissions, session management, and secure data handling.
* Design database schemas, migrations, indexes, relationships, transactions, and query optimization.
* Integrate payment gateways, messaging systems, maps, analytics, AI services, and third-party platforms.
* Understand modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven systems, background jobs, and asynchronous processing.
* Diagnose issues across the entire stack instead of treating frontend and backend as isolated components.

**Preferred technologies:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, and other equivalent production-grade technologies.

5. Automated Deployment & DevOps

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, builds, deployments, and release verification.
* Configure development, staging, and production environments.
* Manage environment variables, secrets, configuration, and database migrations safely.
* Work with GitHub Actions, Docker, cloud hosting, managed databases, and deployment platforms.
* Automate build validation, linting, type checks, test execution, security scanning, and release workflows.
* Implement deployment verification, health checks, rollback procedures, and recovery plans.
* Understand containerization, infrastructure configuration, networking, logs, and application runtime environments.
* Manage production releases with minimal downtime and controlled risk.
* Troubleshoot failed deployments, dependency conflicts, build errors, server issues, and environment-specific bugs.

**Relevant tools:** GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, AWS, GCP, Azure, Railway, Render, Supabase, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools.

6. Quality Assurance & Production Readiness

* Build a reliable testing strategy covering unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and regression testing.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Vitest, Jest, or equivalent frameworks.
* Verify critical business flows before releases, including authentication, payments, bookings, notifications, and admin operations.
* Identify race conditions, edge cases, inconsistent data, permission errors, and failure scenarios.
* Implement structured logging, error tracking, uptime monitoring, and application performance monitoring.
* Use tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and cloud-native monitoring solutions.
* Establish production-readiness checklists, incident response procedures, backup policies, and disaster recovery practices.
* Ensure that an application is not considered complete merely because it works on a developer's machine.

7. Security, Reliability & Scalability

* Apply secure coding practices and follow relevant OWASP guidance.
* Prevent common vulnerabilities such as injection, broken access control, exposed secrets, and insecure API endpoints.
* Protect user data and implement appropriate authorization, validation, rate limiting, and audit logging.
* Understand secure authentication flows, password handling, OAuth, and token management.
* Manage database backups, recovery procedures, dependency vulnerabilities, and access permissions.
* Identify scalability bottlenecks and optimize database queries, API response times, caching, and background processing.
* Establish sensible controls for AI tool permissions, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe agent actions.

8. Technical Documentation & Engineering Operations

* Maintain a clear inventory of all applications, repositories, environments, domains, integrations, and deployment pipelines.
* Document architecture, setup instructions, environment configuration, dependencies, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Track technical debt, recurring production issues, service dependencies, and infrastructure costs.
* Create reusable templates and standards so new applications can be launched consistently.
* Ensure that no critical system depends entirely on undocumented knowledge held by one individual.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical competence in the following areas:

* **Product engineering:** Requirements gathering, feature prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and product lifecycle ownership.
* **Programming:** Strong proficiency in at least one production-grade language, preferably TypeScript or Python.
* **Full-stack fundamentals:** Frontend, backend, REST APIs, authentication, databases, and integrations.
* **Agentic AI:** LLM integration, tool calling, agent orchestration, structured outputs, workflow reliability, and evaluation.
* **AI development tools:** Practical experience with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or comparable AI coding agents.
* **Version control:** Git, GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review.
* **CI/CD:** Automated pipelines, build checks, deployment automation, release verification, and rollback.
* **Cloud and infrastructure:** Practical experience deploying and operating real applications.
* **Testing:** Automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* **Production operations:** Logs, monitoring, incident diagnosis, backups, performance, and reliability.
* **Security:** Secrets management, authorization, secure API design, and dependency management.
* **Technical communication:** Ability to explain architecture, trade-offs, risks, and implementation decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing or maintaining multiple production applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI-powered products or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP servers, reusable agent skills, and tool integrations.
* Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, authentication systems, and database migrations.
* Experience with payment gateways, third-party integrations, and webhook processing.
* Understanding of queues, scheduled jobs, event-driven workflows, and distributed system fundamentals.
* Experience with observability, cloud cost optimization, and infrastructure automation.
* Familiarity with travel technology, marketplaces, booking systems, SaaS products, or consumer applications.
* Experience working in a startup environment with limited resources and high ownership expectations.

What We Expect From You

* Take ownership from problem identification to verified resolution.
* Build and maintain systems instead of relying entirely on other developers or external agencies.
* Make informed decisions about when to code manually, use AI agents, or automate a workflow.
* Prioritize reliability, security, maintainability, and business value over impressive demos.

First 90-Day Success Criteria

* Identify critical bugs, security gaps, undocumented dependencies, and operational risks.
* Create an application inventory, architecture overview, and prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Days 31–60 — Automate and improve**

* Establish reliable CI/CD workflows for priority applications.
* Improve automated testing, monitoring, error reporting, and release procedures.

**Days 61–90 — Deliver and scale**

title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.


You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives** across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* **Translate complex technical and business requirements** into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* **Track and improve AI system performance** through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices**, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*
